vibe.verdict: A good motel postcard that fits a 1955 tour, but the film's snowman line and the big shows are left out.
missing: 'Elvis the Showman and the Colonel the Snowman' (the Colonel)
Gladys holding the 'I Hate Elvis' button at the merchandise meeting (Gladys)
The '68 Comeback Special and 'If I Can Dream' (Steve Binder)
The International Hotel showroom in Las Vegas (the residency)
'That's All Right' on the radio, and the Colonel thinking the singer is black (the Colonel)
The $8,549,761.09 debt the Colonel says Elvis owes (Parker to Vernon)
